name: Weekly lessons review
description: Mondays: compare last week's commits with LESSONS.md and report fixes that left no lesson or test, and lessons due for promotion to the standards. Read only.

steps.name: Review against LESSONS.md
steps.prompt: Read LESSONS.md and docs/development.md. Using the commit list from the previous step, report (1) commits that fix a defect but add no lesson, no new Seen date or no test, with the commit hash and what the lesson should say; (2) lessons whose Seen dates cover three or more days and must move to docs/development.md; (3) user-visible fixes that belong in the next docs/releases/<tag>.md. Do not change files. If everything is in order, end with status no_action.
